en.title: November 4: Korean Braille Turns 100 on an Imo Day's River Water Over Noon Fire - 3 Zodiac Animals With the Best Luck
en.excerpt: Korean Braille's 100th anniversary lands on an Imo day's river water pressed against noon fire, opening the Fire Trine. Here are the three zodiac animals with the best luck today, and why.

fr.title: 4 novembre : le braille coréen fête ses 100 ans sur un jour Imo d'eau de rivière face au feu de midi - 3 signes du zodiaque chinois avec la meilleure chance

ko.title: 11월 4일, 한글 점자 100주년과 임오일의 강물이 한낮의 불을 마주하는 날 - 운 좋은 띠 3가지
